title: FIRST BREAK
description: Win a completed Cipher Duel after submitting at least one guess. Awarded once.

title: CODE CRACKER
description: Solve a Cipher Duel code in four guesses or fewer. Both players must finish; awarded once.

title: MASTER DECODER
description: Solve a Cipher Duel code in three guesses or fewer. Both players must finish; awarded once.

title: UNBREAKABLE
description: Win a completed Cipher Duel while your opponent fails to solve your code. Submit at least one guess; awarded once.

title: RIVALRY
description: Complete ten Cipher Duels against the same member, submitting at least one guess in each. Awarded once.

title: PERFECT READ
description: Solve a Cipher Duel code on your first guess. Both players must finish; awarded once.
